name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 9 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 47 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2025-08-21, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
